claim.quote: A new measurement of the branching ratio, ... This is in agreement with the standard model prediction and improves the test of electron-muon universality to the level of 0.1 %.

date.note: arXiv v1 submission date; the journal version is Phys. Rev. Lett. 115, 071801 (2015). The dataset analysed is the partial 2010 set (arXiv:1509.08437).

name: Improved measurement of the π→eν branching ratio

significance.quote: This is in agreement with the standard model prediction and improves the test of electron-muon universality to the level of 0.1 %.
significance.value: In agreement with the standard model prediction; electron-muon universality tested at the 0.1 % level

summary.plain: PIENU measured how often a charged pion decays to a positron compared with a muon. The result agrees with the Standard Model and tests electron-muon universality to the 0.1 per cent level.
summary.technical: R_e/mu = Gamma(pi+ -> e+ nu(gamma)) / Gamma(pi+ -> mu+ nu(gamma)) = (1.2344 ± 0.0023 (stat) ± 0.0019 (syst)) x 10^-4 from a partial 2010 dataset of about 4 x 10^5 pi -> e nu decays, in agreement with the standard model prediction.

title: Improved measurement of the π→eν branching ratio
why_it_matters: The abstract states the result improves the test of electron-muon universality to the level of 0.1 per cent.
